source.title: Hinterlands Mission VIII: Recover Elunar Relic
source.description: While these demons distract us here, the Emerald Dream is being corrupted into nightmare. Quick, travel through the Emerald Dream Portal in Seradane, and journey to the Nightmare Incursion at Skulk Rock. Retrieve an Elunar Relic the moonkin have hidden there and deliver it to me.
source.objective: Recover an Elunar Relic in the Hinterlands Nightmare Incursion from the high ledge inside Skulk Rock and return to Field Captain Korlian.
source.completion: Well done! Your services shall be well rewarded. Perhaps another mission?
